newsitem.title: USA: Culbro files for spinoff of cigar unit.
newsitem.headline: Culbro files for spinoff of cigar unit.

text.p: Culbro Corp said on Tuesday that its General Cigar Holdings Inc unit filed a registration statement with the Securities and Exchange Commission for a public offering of its stock in February 1997.

Also, General Cigar signed agreements to acquire Villazon and its Honduran affiliates that make and market the Punch and Hoyo de Monterrey cigar brands for $89 million, including the issuance of $25 million in notes, Culbro said.

Culbro said it intends to distribute to its shareholders shares of its non-tobacco businesses, pending a determination that the distribution is tax free and the offering of the cigar unit is successful.
The company said the offering of its cigar business shares will be underwrittend by Donaldson, Lufkin & Jenrette Securities and Smith Barney.
General Cigar is the largest maker and marketer of brand name premium cigars, including the Macanudo and Partagas brands.
The non-tobacco businesses include its nursery business, most of its New England real estate holdings and certain investments, including its stake in Centaur Communications, Culbro said.
